characters.about: Zeus (Greek: Ζεύς/Δίας) was the King of Olympus and the ruler of the Greek Pantheon, as well as the God of the Sky, Thunder, Lightning, Storms, Hospitality and Heavens. Youngest son of the Titans Cronos and Rhea, he was the brother of Hades, Poseidon as well as Demeter, Hestia and Hera - whom he would also wed. He fathered a line of all-powerful deities such as Athena, Ares, Hephaestus, Persephone, Zagreus, Aphrodite, Artemis, Apollo, Hermes and Dionysus as well as many mortal children such as Hercules, Kratos, Deimos, Perseus, Pollux, Peirithous, Minos and countless others.
characters.quote: My brothers. We were forged in victory. A victory that ended the great war and brought forth the reign of mount Olympus. Born from the depths of the underworld, rooted in the river of souls, our mountain emerged out of the chaos. As it grew, so too did the might of the Olympians. We created a world of peace, a world of prosperity. A world that lives in the shadow and safety of my mountain. A mountain that has come to be the absolute measure of strength and power. Now, on this day, that power is to be tested. The mortal, Kratos, seeks to destroy all that I have wrought. Brothers, put aside the petty grievances that have splintered us for so long. We will unite. We will stand together. And I will wipe out this plague! Olympus will prevail! –Zeus to his fellow gods, Poseidon, Hades, Helios and Hermes.

characters.title: Alrik
characters.about: Alrik, better known as the Barbarian King, was the leader of the Barbarian army, a strong warrior himself and an old enemy of Kratos. He was killed by the Spartan after the latter gained the Blades of Chaos. He and his brutish army drove Kratos to beg Ares to save him, leading to the events of God of War: Ascension and thus the entire series.
characters.quote: This time, Ghost of Sparta, I will have your head! –The Barbarian King to Kratos

characters.title: Aphrodite
characters.about: Aphrodite (Αφροδίτη) is the Olympian Goddess of Love and Beauty, and one of the many supporting characters in the God of War series.
characters.quote: Kratos, it's been far too long. Even though you are no longer the God of War, you can still share my bed. –Aphrodite inviting Kratos to her bed

characters.title: Aphrodite's Handmaidens
characters.about: Aphrodite's Handmaidens are the servants and lovers of the Olympic Goddess of Love, Aphrodite. Appear briefly in God of War III.
characters.quote: Handmaiden 1: Why does Aphrodite always get to have all of the fun? Handmaiden 2: When will it be our turn? –Handmaidens watching Kratos and Aphrodite have intercourse

characters.title: Apollo
appearsIn: God of War Sons of Sparta (Mentioned)
characters.about: Apollo (Greek: Ἀπόλλων) is the Olympian God of Light, Music, The Sun, Day, Healing, Diseases, Enlightenment, Oracles, Art, Celebration, Entertainment, Stories, Archery, Truth, Prophecy. Knowledge, Logic and Science. He is the son of Zeus and Leto as well as the younger twin brother of Artemis. Despite his prominent status in mythology, he has never appeared in person in the series.
characters.quote: But this is the power of the god Apollo. Neither you nor the Tree of Life can survive his Olympian flames. –Kratos

characters.title: Atropos
aliases: Measurer of the Threads of Fate
appearsIn: God of War: Chains of Olympus (mentioned)
God of War: Ghost of Sparta (mentioned)
characters.about: Atropos (Greek: Ἄτροπος) is one of the three Sisters of Fate, the oldest sister and the measurer of threads who determines the life of everyone, be they mortal or god. She is defeated along with her younger sister, Lahkesis, when Kratos traps them inside their own mirror and shatters it.
characters.quote: And now that life is at an end. We control your destiny, foolish mortal! With a whim we can end your life… or allow you to live. –Atropos.

characters.title: Boreas
appearsIn: God of War: Chains of Olympus (mentioned)
God of War: Ghost of Sparta (mentioned)
characters.about: Boreas (Greek: Βορέας) is the Olympian God of North Wind, Storms, Winter, Loneliness, Solitude, Absence, Lack, Sadness, Depression, Calmness and Serenity. He leads the path of the Sun Chariot of Helios along with three horses that drive it, called the Fire Steeds.

characters.title: Callisto
appearsIn: God of War Sons of Sparta (mentioned only)
God of War (treasure room cutscenes; non-canon)
God of War: Ghost of Sparta
characters.about: Callisto (Greek: Καλλιστώ) was a Spartan woman and mother of Kratos and Deimos, and was also one of Zeus' many lovers. She was kept within the city of Atlantis, until Kratos' arrival in the city.
characters.quote: Punish me for my shortcomings, and grant my son redemption. –Callisto.

characters.title: Captain
appearsIn: God of War Sons of Sparta
characters.about: The Captain was the leading sailor of a fleet of ships that once sailed the Aegean Sea during the events of God of War, when Kratos was tasked with killing the Hydra King as part of his service to the Gods of Olympus. However, despite being momentarily saved from falling into the Hydra's stomach by Kratos, the warrior only did so to obtain the key he had on him before letting him fall to his death inside the creature's carcass.
characters.quote: He could have saved me. He held my life in his hand, and still he let go. I may have been just a mere boat captain, but he treated me as if I was nothing! He is to blame for my torment here! I hope he suffers in Hades as I have. Damn that Ghost of Sparta! –Boat Captain

characters.title: Chaos
appearsIn: God of War Sons of Sparta (mentioned only)
characters.about: Chaos (Greek: χάος) is the original Greek Primordial entity who personifies life itself and is the mother/grandmother of the other Primordial deities, one of whom gave birth to the Titans, who in turn birthed the Gods of Olympus.
characters.quote: This world is the birthright of those who were born to the son of Chaos, father of the Universe. –Gyges

characters.title: Charon
appearsIn: God of War: Chains of Olympus
characters.about: Charon (Greek: Χάρων) was the ferryman of the Underworld and a boss in God of War: Chains of Olympus.
characters.quote: We share a common fate, Kratos, the gods will release neither of us from our torture. –Charon.

characters.title: Clotho
aliases: Spinner of the Threads of Fate
appearsIn: God of War: Chains of Olympus (mentioned)
God of War: Ghost of Sparta (mentioned)
characters.about: Clotho (Greek: Κλωθώ) is one of the three Primordial Sisters of Fate, the youngest sister and the spinner of the threads as she is the one who begins life and decides who will be born and when. She is the last of the sisters to be defeated and the only one to be physically killed by Kratos, when he invades the Palace of the Fates to use the loom and change his fate.
characters.quote: It is through my threads that all life is born. You must not tamper with destiny, Kratos. You will destroy everything. –Clotho.

characters.title: Cronos
aliases: Father of the Gods of Olympus
The youngest child of Earth and Sky
appearsIn: God of War Sons of Sparta (mentioned)
characters.about: Cronos (Greek: Κρόνος), was the leader and last of the mighty Titans who were born to Gaia and Ouranos. He fathered the first of the Olympians with his wife Rhea. He fought in the Titanomachy where he was overthrown by his son Zeus. His punishment by Zeus after the battle was to forever carry Pandora's Temple on his back in chains. He is a minor character in God of War, a minor ally in God of War II and a major antagonist in God of War III.
characters.quote: You killed Ares out of your need for vengeance. But this time, retribution finally comes to me, Spartan. –Cronos to Kratos.

characters.title: Daedalus
characters.quote: What have you done with my child? My boy! WHERE IS MY BOY? –Daedalus.

characters.title: Epimetheus
characters.about: Epimetheus (Ἐπιμηθεύς) was a Titan of Hindsight and Afterthought, he was sent to Tartarus after he was defeated in the Great War by Zeus.

characters.title: Gaia
appearsIn: God of War Sons of Sparta (mentioned)
God of War: Chains of Olympus (Narrator)
God of War: Ghost of Sparta (Narrator and mentioned)
God of War II (Narrator and Titan)
characters.about: Gaia (Greek: Γαῖα) is the Primordial Goddess of the Earth, mother of the Titans and the grandmother/great-grandmother of the Olympian Gods. She is the narrator of the series, the deuteragonist of God of War II, and the secondary antagonist of God of War III.
characters.quote: I am the Titan, Gaia; ever-present Mother of Earth. I have watched you become a powerful warrior, and I have been with you through all the events of your life, but I can no longer simply watch. –Gaia.

characters.title: Hades
appearsIn: God of War Sons of Sparta (mentioned)
God of War: Chains of Olympus (mentioned)
characters.about: Hades (Greek: ᾍδης), also known as Háidēs or Pluto, was the Olympian God of the Dead and the Ruler of the Underworld. Eldest son of the mighty titan Cronos and his queen Rhea, he was most notoriously known as the brother of Zeus and Poseidon as well as Demeter, Hera and Hestia. The firstborn son of Cronos was the supreme ruler of the afterlife and the dead in the Greek world. Furthermore, Hades was the husband of Persephone and the uncle of Kratos himself — a family bond that the latter has long been unaware of.
characters.quote: Kratos, so glad you could carve out some time for us! You know we need it. I sense some bad blood between us, Kratos. Oh, all the memories. They're overwhelming, really. Let's see... How many sins have you committed against me? Oh, that's right, you murdered my niece, Athena! And what else. WHAT else? Ah, and you killed my brother, Poseidon. And I have not forgotten that it was you who butchered my beautiful Queen! I will see you suffer as I have suffered. Your soul is MINE. –Hades before engaging Kratos in battle.

characters.title: Helios
characters.voiceActor: Crispin Freeman (God of War III) & (God of War Ragnarök: Valhalla)
appearsIn: God of War: Chains of Olympus
characters.about: Helios (Greek: Ἥλιος) was the Titan God of the Sun and Guardian of Oaths. He is a major background character God of War: Chains of Olympus, a major antagonist in God of War III and a minor but key character in God of War: Ragnarök: Valhalla.
characters.quote: Behold the glory of Helios! –Helios

characters.title: Hephaestus
appearsIn: God of War: Chains of Olympus (mentioned only)
God of War Ragnarök: Valhalla (mentioned Only)
characters.about: Hephaestus (Greek: Hφαιστος) is the Craftsman of Olympus, as well as the God of Smithery and Craftswork. He starts off as an ally in God of War III, but later betrays and tries to murder Kratos in order to protect Pandora from the Flame of Olympus.
characters.quote: Zeus may have imprisoned me here, but you are the reason I live in torment. –Hephaestus to Kratos, God of War III

characters.title: Hera
characters.about: Hera (Greek: Ἥρα) was the Olympian Goddess of Women and Marriage, and the sister and wife of Zeus. She was also the mother of Ares and Hephaestus. She is also Queen of the Gods. She is a minor antagonist in God of War III.
characters.quote: Bravo! Bravo! Our hero has arrived. Applause for another bastard child of Zeus, just in time for the final act. –Hera.

characters.title: Hercules
appearsIn: God of War Ragnarök: Valhalla (mentioned only)
characters.about: Hercules (Greek: Herakles/Ἡρακλῆς) was the son of Zeus and Alcmene, and paternal half-brother of Athena, Ares, Hephaestus, Aphrodite, Persephone, Zagreus, Artemis, Apollo, Hermes, Dionysus, Kratos and Deimos. As a mortal, he was tasked with twelve labors in order to gain redemption for the murder of his family. Being called to Mount Olympus in order to defend it with the Olympian Gods against Kratos and the Titans he brought from the past, Hercules would consider it his thirteenth and final labor to rid Olympus of Kratos once and for all.
characters.quote: Think about it, brother. While I was stuck cleaning the Augean stables, he chose you to destroy Ares! Not convinced? How about this? While you were being crowned the God of War, I was sent to find an apple. They called them "labors". HA! Perhaps he did allow me to kill the Nemean Lion, but he made your name known amongst the people! A fierce warrior! A killer made hero! A MAN MADE A GOD! But this time, brother... This time I will destroy you. Call it my thirteenth and final labor. Soon I will become the God of War and claim the throne for myself! –Hercules to Kratos.

characters.title: Hydra
appearsIn: God of War Sons of Sparta (mentioned)
characters.about: The Hydra was a multi-headed sea monster that terrorized the Aegean Sea and was the first boss in God of War.
characters.quote: Kratos, before you reach Athens, there is a task you must complete. This beast, this Hydra, it has terrorized my seas for far too long. –Poseidon.

characters.title: Hyperion
aliases: The father of the Sun and the Moon
appearsIn: God of War: Chains of Olympus
God of War: Sons of Sparta (mentioned)
characters.about: Hyperion (Greek: Ὑπερίων) was one of the almighty Titans of Greek Mythology and a character in the God of War Series. He was the master of the sun before his son Helios, and is also the father of Eos and Selene.

characters.title: Icarus
characters.quote: Go back. Go back, warrior. There is no passage here. You will never make it across. You think you can, but you cannot. Do you hear me?! It is my wings that will make it across. It is my test! Do you not know who I am‽ Have you not heard of Icarus? It is my fate to make it across, NONE OTHER! This is my test! The sisters will grant me an audience, not you. You will die, white warrior! You will die! –Icarus.

characters.title: King Aeacus
characters.quote: King Aeacus has found you wanting. –King Minos

characters.title: King Minos
characters.quote: By the Gods of Olympus, and order of Zeus, we are the Three Judges. Face your final judgement, mortal. King Aeacus has found you wanting. King Rhadamanthus has found you worthy. It falls to me, King Minos, to make the final decision. Your future is cloaked in shadow. The realm of the afterlife is not yet ready for you. Beyond that door waits your destiny. –King Minos

characters.title: King Rhadamanthus
characters.quote: King Rhadamanthus has found you worthy. –King Minos.

characters.title: Lahkesis
aliases: Executioner of the Threads of Fate
appearsIn: God of War: Chains of Olympus (mentioned)
God of War: Ghost of Sparta (mentioned)
characters.about: Lahkesis (Greek: Λάχεσις) is one of the three Primordial Sisters of Fate, the middle sister and the executioner of the threads of fate, as she is the one who ends the lives of every mortal, God, and Titan, before releasing them to the afterlife. She is defeated along with her older sister, Atropos, when they are trapped in their mirror as Kratos breaks it.
characters.quote: It was I who deemed that the Titans lose the Great War…and I who have allowed you to come this far. –Lahkesis

characters.title: Last Spartan
aliases: Last Spartan (Earned as he was the only spartan to survive Zeus's attack)
characters.voiceActor: God of War: Ghost of Sparta: Gideon Emery
appearsIn: God of War: Ghost of Sparta
characters.about: The Last Spartan was a young Spartan commander who was very loyal to Kratos during his time as the God of War and was one of the few people Kratos actually cared for besides his family. He received his title due to him being the only mortal Spartan survivor after the betrayal of Zeus.
characters.quote: I have faith that our brothers of Sparta will live on through the true God of War. –The Last Spartan.

characters.title: Lysandra
characters.voiceActor: Gwendoline Yeo (God of War & God of War III)
appearsIn: God of War Sons of Sparta (mentioned)
God of War: Chains of Olympus (flashback)
characters.about: Lysandra (Greek: Λυσάνδρα) was a Spartan woman who was Kratos' first wife and mother to his daughter, Calliope. Though Kratos had many women in his time, he felt truly connected to Lysandra and considered her his soul mate and true love. Lysandra was also the only person who did not fear Kratos during his time as a brutal Spartan captain, and, on more than one occasion, questioned his reasons for the reckless slaughter of many innocent people.
characters.quote: You can see the light, it is changing you, it is time to lay your fears to rest, the light reveals the truth, the power of forgiveness comes from within. To be forgiven you must find the power to forgive yourself. –Lysandra, in Kratos' Psyche

characters.title: Nike
appearsIn: God of War Sons of Sparta (mentioned)
God of War: Chains of Olympus (Statue)
characters.about: Nike (Greek: Νίκη) is the Olympian Goddess of Victory. She is the daughter of the Oceanid Styx and Titan Pallas.
characters.quote: Victory favors you, Kratos. But you must grab hold of your destiny and command it. –Gaia

characters.title: Oceanus
appearsIn: God of War: Sons of Sparta (mentioned only)
characters.about: Oceanus ( Ὠκεανός), known as the great river girdling the world, was a God of War II character ultimately cut from its final version, before appearing in God of War III during the siege of Mount Olympus. He was ultimately killed by Hades when Kratos attempted to climb up the mountain to reach Zeus.

characters.title: Pandora
aliases: The Blacksmith's Daughter (by Kratos and Týr)
appearsIn: God of War Ragnarök: Valhalla (Flashback only)
characters.about: Pandora (Πανδώρα, "All gifts") is the living key, creation and adoptive daughter of Hephaestus and the tritagonist of God of War III'.
characters.quote: Hope is what makes us strong. It is why we are here. It's what we fight with when all else is lost. –Pandora

characters.title: Peirithous
characters.about: Peirithous (Greek: Πειρίθοος) was a Demigod who was kept prisoner of Hades, condemned to eternal suffering in the Underworld.
characters.quote: I have suffered enough, Spartan. Hades, he sent me to this eternal torture. My prison of tinder. But now that you are here, you can free me! All I have left is my bow. Please, free me and it is yours. –Peirithous.

characters.title: Persephone
appearsIn: God of War: Chains of Olympus
characters.about: Persephone (Greek: Περσεφόνη) is the Olympian Goddess of Spring, Queen of the Underworld, and the main antagonist in God of War: Chains of Olympus.
characters.quote: Do you think it was my choice to wed a man I did not love? Live a life I did not choose? I was betrayed by the very gods that once saw me as their own. But no more. –Persephone.

characters.title: Perses
characters.about: Perses (Πέρσης) is one of the great Titans that takes part in the Second Titanomachy in God of War III.

characters.title: Poseidon's Princess
characters.about: Poseidon's Princess is a minor character and unwilling ally of Kratos in God of War III. She is the enslaved concubine of Poseidon, found chained up in his personal quarters.
characters.quote: Lord Kratos, do not leave me! –Poseidon Princess.

characters.title: Skorpius
characters.about: The Queen of the Scorpions, or Skorpius, dwells deep within the caverns below Mount Olympus.
characters.quote: Ah, good, good. You have the icestorm. The Scorpion must be defeated. –Daedalus

characters.title: Tartarus
characters.about: Tartarus (Greek: τάρταρος) is the Primordial entity of the Abyss and one of the first children of Chaos, brother to Gaia and Nyx and is also the deepest part of the Underworld, where most of the Titans were imprisoned by Zeus after their defeat in the first Titanomachy.
characters.quote: Here is where the souls of the wicked are tortured in the pits of Tartarus, the wailing and agony of the damned, resonated deep throughout the bowels of the Underworld. –Gaia

characters.title: Typhon
appearsIn: God of War Sons of Sparta (mentioned)
characters.about: Typhon (Greek: Τυφῶν) is a Titan with power over the wind and storms, who was sealed in the mountains after he was defeated by Zeus after challenging the King of the Gods.
characters.quote: Get out of my sight, Olympian... –Typhon

characters.title: Zephyrus
appearsIn: God of War: Chains of Olympus
characters.about: Zephyros (Greek: Ζέφυρος) is a horse-like Immortal being who is the Olympian God of the West Wind, Spring, Fertility, Procreation, Hope, Rebirth, Luck, Flowers, Bees and Honey. He walks the path of the Sun Chariot of Helios, and is one of the three horses that drives it, called the Fire Steeds.

characters.title: Aesop
characters.about: Aesop was a Greek storyteller. Author of many popular fables that were shared all across Greece.
characters.quote: There was a man I knew of long ago... His stories were brief and purposeful. –Kratos

characters.title: Andvari
characters.about: Andvari was a powerful enchanter and formerly served as an ally of Kratos and Atreus. He was Brok's friend some years prior to the game. He is a supportive character in God of War (2018).

characters.title: Ask
characters.about: Ask was the first Midgardian man created by Odin.

characters.title: Aurvandil
appearsIn: The Lost Pages of Norse Myth (mentioned)
characters.about: Aurvandil was a renowned warrior in Norse Mythology, and the husband of Gróa.

characters.title: Auðumbla
characters.about: Auðumbla is the Primordial Cow that fed Ymir with her milk and was the one who formed Búri out of the ice.
characters.quote: Great Auðumbla's udders that's the Unity Stone! –Mimir about Auðumbla

characters.title: Bergelmir
characters.about: Bergelmir also known as Bergelmir Thrúðgelmirson (Translation: Bergelmir, Son of Thrúðgelmir) and Bergelmir the Beloved, was a Frost Giant and the founder of Jötunheim. He is a character featured in God of War (2018).
characters.quote: Bergelmir and his queen survived the flood of Ymir's blood, and founded Jötunheim. They did NOT seek revenge, except to live and see his kind prosper, "Bergelmir the Beloved" ---- A happy ending! –Codex

characters.title: Blóðughadda
characters.about: Blóðughadda is a Norse Goddess of Waves and one of the Nine Daughters of Ægir and Rán.

characters.title: Borr
characters.about: Borr, also known as Borr Búrison (Translation: Borr, Son of Búri) is the Creator God, son of Búri and the grandson of Ymir. He was a member of the Aesir Royal Family, being father of Odin, Vili, and Vé.

characters.title: Bragi
appearsIn: The Lost Pages of Norse Myth (mentioned only)
characters.about: Bragi (Old Norse: Brɑɣe) is Norse God of Poetry and Music, and husband of Iðunn.

characters.title: Brenna Dauði
characters.about: Brenna Dauði is a Fire Troll and a boss in God of War (2018).

characters.title: Bylgja
characters.about: Bylgja is a Norse Goddess of Waves and one of the Nine Daughters of Ægir and Rán.

characters.title: Chaurli
characters.about: Chaurli is the giant tortoise that lives above Freya's home, as thanks for having saved her, since she was confined to the forests of Midgard, without escaping from the Aesir.
characters.quote: Atreus: How's it going, Chaurli? Is your witch friend here? Kratos: What is that name? Atreus: That's what he told me it was - or what it sounded like in my head anyway. Chaurli! –Atreus and Kratos

characters.title: Dagsetr
characters.about: Dagsetr is a male Dragon and the flying mount of Baldur in God of War (2018).
characters.quote: Freya: Know anything about the frozen dragon? Kratos: It… was Baldur’s. He took Atreus, and tried to escape with him. We fought on its back. Freya: The things he put you through… Kratos: Odin gave the commands. The blame is his. –Freya to Kratos at Demise of Dagestr

characters.title: Dauði Hamarr
characters.about: Dauði Hamarr, also known as Death's Hammer, is a fire Troll and an optional boss in God of War (2018).

characters.title: Dauði Munr
characters.about: Dauði Munr is a Troll and a boss in God of War (2018).

characters.title: Death Eater
characters.about: Death Eater is a Troll and an optional boss in God of War (2018).

characters.title: Drǫfn
characters.about: Drǫfn is a Norse Goddess of Waves and one of the Nine Daughters of Ægir and Rán.

characters.title: Duraþrór
aliases: One of the Stags Across the Realms
characters.about: Duraþrór is the one of the stags across the Nine Realms. He appears as a statue in God of War (2018) and physically in God of War Ragnarök.
characters.quote: A stag of the World Tree who watches the gates of Jötunheim (Where Giants come from). This really IS the Giants' mountain! –Codex

characters.title: Dúfa
characters.about: Dúfa is a Norse Goddess of Waves and one of the Nine Daughters of Ægir and Rán.

characters.title: Eir
characters.about: Eir is a Valkyrie introduced in God of War (2018). She is one of the nine Valkyries who have been cursed by Odin to remain in a corporal form, eventually driving them to insanity. As she became too dangerous, Eir eventually found herself sealed away by the Valkyrie Queen in Midgard. She is nevertheless freed by Kratos and Atreus after they engaged and defeated her physical form. Blessing them with her eternal gratitude, her spirit vanished and eventually reunited with her sisters.
characters.quote: The Healer. Strange, for a Valkyrie. Very quiet. Very calm. Where her sisters were violent rapids, Eir was a gentle stream. She healed the wounds of both mortals and gods... and even a certain all-knowing sage who once drank too much and fell off a mountain. –Mimir's remarks about Eir

characters.title: Eis
appearsIn: God of War Sons of Sparta
characters.about: Atreus of Sparta or Eis was a Spartan and an Agoge Cadet. Atreus of Sparta fought in many wars alongside Kratos.
characters.quote: All Spartans are great warriors. We train from birth. Our lives were discipline, duty, battle, and death. Life was grim, and we greeted it grimly. But Atreus of Sparta was unlike the rest of us. He wore a smile even in the worst of times. He was happy. He inspired us to hope... that though we were machines of war, yet there was humanity in us. Goodness. When the day came for him to lay down his life in battle, his sacrifice saved countless others, and turned the tide in our favor. I carried him home on his shield, and buried him with all the honors of Spartan custom. His memory was a comfort in dark times. –Kratos to Atreus

characters.title: Embla
characters.about: Embla was the first Midgardian woman created by Odin.

characters.title: Fafnir
characters.about: Fafnir was a Dwarf who turned into a Dragon. He makes his only appearance in God of War (2018).

characters.title: Fjörgyn
appearsIn: God of War: Lore and Legends (mentioned only)
characters.about: Fjörgyn was a Jötunn and Goddess who is the personification of Earth and Trees. She was also a wife of Odin, the mother of Thor and grandmother of Magni, Modi and Thrúd.
characters.quote: Here we bear witness to the funeral rites of Fjörgyn of the Jötnar, goddess of the earth and trees. For her beauty she was seduced, for her love she was betrayed, and for her gift of life, her life was claimed. To the summit and across the bridge she shall be borne, where nevermore the Thunder may find her. –Rites of Fjörgyn

characters.title: Freyr
characters.about: Freyr (Old Norse: Frey, Nordic: ᚠᚱᛅᚢᛦ), also known as Freyr Njördson (Translation: Freyr, Son of Njörd) and Yngvi, is the Vanir God of Rain and Fertility. He is the son of Njörd and Nerthus, the younger twin brother of Freya, and the uncle of Baldur.
characters.quote: We lost everything to that maniac you called HUSBAND. The man's family set me on fire. –Freyr, to Freya

characters.title: Grendel of the Ashes
characters.about: Grendel of the Ashes is Troll and a boss in God of War (2018).

characters.title: Gróa
appearsIn: The Lost Pages of Norse Myth (mentioned)
characters.about: Gróa was a powerful Jötunn seeress in Norse Mythology, and the wife of Aurvandil.
characters.quote: All-Father, your presence honors me, but now is not the best time. –Gróa's last words

characters.title: Gunnr
characters.about: Gunnr is a Valkyrie introduced in God of War (2018). She is one of the nine Valkyries who have been cursed by Odin to remain in a corporal form, eventually driving them to insanity. As she became too dangerous, Gunnr eventually found herself sealed away by the Valkyrie Queen in Midgard. She is nevertheless freed by Kratos and Atreus after they engaged and defeated her physical form. Blessing them with her eternal gratitude, her spirit vanished and eventually reunited with her sisters.
characters.quote: Mistress of War. After any conflict, big or small, she would be first on the scene, sussing out the worthy spirits for a free trip to Valhalla. A gruesome task, but she took great pride in it. Her judgement of the fallen was unparalleled, and an invaluable resource to Odin. She was one of his favorites. –Mimir’s remarks about Gunnr

characters.title: Hefring
characters.about: Hefring is a Norse Goddess of Waves and one of the Nine Daughters of Ægir and Rán.

characters.title: Heimdall
aliases: Prize-Winning Taint Stain with a Capital Stank (by Brok)
appearsIn: God of War (2018) (mentioned and pictured only)
characters.about: Heimdall (Old Norse: Heimdallr, Nordic: ᚺᛖᛁᛗᛞᚨᛚᛚ), also known as Heimdall Odinson (Translation: Heimdall, Son of Odin), also famed as the Watchman of the Aesir, the Bearer of Gjallarhorn and the Herald of Ragnarök, was the Norse God of Foresight, Surveillance, Order and, Foreknowledge and Prince of Asgard. He is a member of the Aesir Royal Family, being the son of Odin and the Nine Daughters of Ægir and Rán, step-son of Frigg, younger half-brother of Thor and Týr, older half-brother of Baldur, uncle of Magni, Modi, Forseti and Thrúd.
characters.quote: Don’t you know who I am? I am the watchman of the Aesir! The Herald of Ragnarök! –Heimdall during his duel with Kratos

characters.title: Hel
characters.about: Hel (Nordic: ᚺᛖᛚ) is the daughter of Loki and Angrboða. She is the Goddess of Death and future ruler of Helheim, succeeding Hræsvelgr.

characters.title: Hildisvíni
appearsIn: God of War Ragnarök: Valhalla (mentioned only)
characters.about: Hildsvini is a Vanir God, archer and Freya's Advisor. While in Midgard, he was trapped in the form of a boar and was Freya's friend during her stay in the Wildwoods.
characters.quote: Counselor to the Vanir. And yes, while exiled at Midgard, I was trapped in my boar form. And then you shot me. –Hildisvíni to Kratos and Atreus

characters.title: Himinglæva
characters.about: Himinglæva is a Norse Goddess of Waves and one of the Nine Daughters of Ægir and Rán.

characters.title: Hrimthur
appearsIn: God of War (2018) (mentioned and pictured only)
characters.about: Hrimthur was a Jötunn and the son of Thamur.

characters.title: Hrungnir
characters.about: Hrungnir was a Jötunn featured in God of War (2018).

characters.title: Hræsvelgr
characters.about: Hræsvelgr is a Jötunn who appears in God of War (2018) and God of War Ragnarök. She is the current ruler of Helheim, also known by her title of "Hel", being perched atop its tallest building and gazing down upon the Realm and its residents.
characters.quote: We have spoken to the eagle that presides here in Helheim. She watched from afar while I battled the Bridge Keeper in our prior journey. Now, by releasing Garm, we have opened six tears to Helheim. Hræsvelgr is not pleased, but does not appear to be our enemy. That is for the best. –Kratos' thoughts about Hræsvelgr

characters.title: Hrímfaxi
appearsIn: God of War (2018) (mentioned and pictured only)

characters.title: Hrǫnn
characters.about: Hrǫnn is a Norse Goddess of Waves and one of the Nine Daughters of Ægir and Rán.

characters.title: Hymir
characters.about: Hymir (Old Norse: hymez) is a male Jötunn.

characters.title: Hœnir
appearsIn: The Lost Pages of Norse Myth (mentioned only)
characters.about: Hœnir is Norse God of Silence, Indecision, Mystery and Avoidance.

characters.title: Ivaldi
characters.about: Ivaldi was a Dwarf alchemist who experimented with Niflheim's frost power, eventually leading to his death.

characters.title: Iðunn
appearsIn: The Lost Pages of Norse Myth (mentioned only)
characters.about: Iðunn is the Goddess of Spring and Eternal Youth, she guards the Apples of Youth and wife of Bragi.

characters.title: Járn Fótr
characters.about: Járn Fótr is a Troll and a boss in God of War (2018).

characters.title: Járnsaxa
characters.about: Járnsaxa (/jɑːrnˈsæksə/; Old Norse: [ˈjɑːrnˌsɑksɑ], "iron dagger") is a Jötunn in Norse mythology. In Snorri Sturluson's Prose Edda, she is Thor's lover and the mother of Magni.
characters.quote: Thor's their dad. Different moms-sordid story, that one. Baldur's their uncle, Odin, dear ol' Grandpa. –Sindri talking about Magni and Modi to Kratos

characters.title: Kólga
characters.about: Kólga is a Norse Goddess of Waves and one of the Nine Daughters of Ægir and Rán.

characters.title: Magni
characters.about: Magni (Old Norse: Mágni, Nordic: ᛗᚨᚷᚾᛁ), also known as Magni Thorson (Translation: Magni, Son of Thor), was the eldest son of Thor and Járnsaxa as well as grandson of Odin and Fjörgyn, nephew of Týr, Heimdall and Baldur, older half-brother of Modi and Thrúd. He is the tertiary antagonist of the God of War (2018) game. Both him and his brother accompanied their uncle, Baldur, on his mission to hunt down Kratos and Atreus, with the aim of bringing them to Odin in Asgard.
characters.quote: Surrender. The Allfather demands it. –Magni to Kratos

characters.title: Mani
characters.about: Mani (Old Norse: Máni) also known as Mani Mundilfœrison (Translation: Mani, Son of Mundilfœri) and "The Moon " is the God of the moon and brother to the sun Goddess Sol. He and his sister are destined to die at the jaws of Sköll and Hati in the beginning of Ragnarök.

characters.title: Modi
characters.about: Modi (Old Norse: Móði, Nordic: ᛗᛟᛞᛁ) also known as Modi Thorson (Translation: Modi, Son of Thor) was the Norse God of Courage and Wrath. Son of Thor and Sif, the nephew of Týr, Heimdall and Baldur, the younger half-brother of Magni, and older brother of Thrúd. He is the secondary antagonist of God of War (2018). Modi and his half-brother both followed their uncle Baldur in their quest to find and kill Kratos and Atreus.
characters.quote: You ruined everything. I earned that fucking hammer, but now everyone's gonna think I only got it 'cause Magni's gone. I'll be a joke. But if I kill you — no one's gonna laugh at me. –Modi to Kratos

characters.title: Máttugr Helson
characters.about: Máttugr Helson (Nordic: ᛗᚨᛏᛏᚢᚷᚱ ᚺᛖᛚᛋᛟᚾ) is a Troll known as "The Bridge Keeper", and is a boss in God of War (2018).
characters.quote: We have spoken to the eagle that presides here in Helheim. She watched from afar while I battled the Bridge Keeper in our prior journey. Now, by releasing Garm, we have opened six tears to Helheim. Hræsvelgr is not pleased, but does not appear to be our enemy. That is for the best. –Kratos' thoughts about Hræsvelgr in Codex

characters.title: Mótsognir
characters.about: Mótsognir is a character in God of War (2018).
characters.quote: I hope that forfeiting my morality during this damned search would be enough. Now I see it was my own sacrifice that was required. –Mótsognir

characters.title: Nal
characters.about: Nal, along with her husband Bergelmir are the founder of Jötunheim and she is a character featured in God of War (2018).

characters.title: Nanna
characters.about: Nanna (Old Norse: Nana), also known as Nanna Neprsdóttir (Translation: Nanna, Daughter of Nepr) is the Norse Goddess of Joy, Devotion, Peace and Loyalty. She is the daughter of Nepr and Nofn.
characters.quote: Sweet Nanna's nethers! –Brok to Kratos

characters.title: Nornir
characters.about: The Nornir are the Norse Goddesses of Fate. They are also the Norse counterpart of the Greek Goddesses of Fate, the Sisters of Fate.
characters.quote: There is no grand design. No script. Only the choices you make. That your choices are so predictable merely makes us seem prescient. –The Norns revealing the truth about fate.

characters.title: Otr
characters.about: Otr is one of the three dragons captured by the Dwarf King Mótsognir.

characters.title: Ratatoskr
characters.voiceActor: Troy Baker (God of War (2018); as "Bitter Squirrel" & God of War Ragnarok
characters.about: Ratatoskr is a squirrel who guards the World Tree of Yggdrasil.
characters.quote: My goodness, what a strapping physique. Capable of an astounding variety of acts of violence, I imagine. –Ratatoskr inspects Kratos

characters.title: Sif
characters.about: Sif (Nordic: ᛊᛁᚠ), also known as Sif Mandifarisdóttir (Translation: Sif, Daughter of Mandifari) is the Norse Goddess of Wheat, Earth, Harvest and Family. She is the second wife of Thor, the daughter-in-law of Odin and Fjörgyn, the stepmother of Magni and mother of Modi and Thrúd.
characters.quote: You said no more Aesir blood would be spilled. You said family comes first. You don’t think that this is retribution for him being here? He's put your granddaughter in danger. He's made your son miserable. –Sif to Odin about Loki

characters.title: Sigrún
characters.about: Sigrún is the Valkyrie Queen introduced in God of War (2018). She is one of the nine Valkyries who have been cursed into insanity by Odin. Although the incredible amount of power she possesses allowed her to resist much longer than her sisters, she inevitably lost herself as well. She is nevertheless freed by Kratos and Atreus after they engaged and defeated her physical form in a long and difficult battle. Blessing them with her eternal gratitude, her spirit vanished and eventually reunited with her sisters.
characters.quote: Queen of the Valkyries, although she does not appear to refer to herself as such. When Freya, the original Queen Valkyrie, lost her wings to Odin, Sigrún grudgingly took the position in her stead. Now she is free to reunite the Valkyries and attempt to stem the tide of the dead flowing into Midgard. –Mimir's remarks about Sigrún

characters.title: Skaði
characters.about: Skaði also known as Skaði Thiazzisdottir (Translation: Skaði, Daughter of Thiazzi) is a female Jötunn featured in God of War (2018). Is the Norse Goddess of Winter, Skiing, Bowhunting, and Mountains.

characters.title: Skinfaxi
appearsIn: God of War (2018) (mentioned and pictured only)

characters.title: Sköll and Hati
characters.about: Sköll (Old Norse: Skǫll) and Hati are two Giant wolves featured in God of War (2018) and God of War Ragnarök. They are legendary for chasing down the Sun and Moon.

characters.title: Sleipnir
appearsIn: God of War (2018) (mentioned and pictured only)
characters.about: Sleipnir is an eight-legged horse and Odin's horse who traveled with him on many journeys and realms.

characters.title: Sol
characters.about: Sol (Old Norse: Sól) also known as Sol Mundilfœrisdottir (Translation: Sol, Daughter of Mundilfœri) is the Goddess of the sun and sister to the moon God Mani. She and her brother are destined to die at the jaws of Sköll and Hati in the beginning of Ragnarök.

characters.title: Starkaðr
characters.about: Starkaðr, also called Starkaðr the Mighty, was a Jötunn featured in God of War (2018).
characters.quote: A Giant with eight arms, swinging four swords... until Thor chopped him up. Why did the Gods gang up on him? –Codex

characters.title: Stonebeard King
characters.about: Stonebeard King is a Troll and a boss in God of War (2018).

characters.title: Thamur
characters.about: Thamur was a Jötunn who, before his death, attempted to build a wall around Jötunheim as a way to protect his people from Thor during the war between Giants and Aesir. However, when searching for his son, Hrimthur in Midgard, he was attacked by Thor, resulting in a fierce battle in which a blow from Thor caused Thamur to fall onto his own chisel, subsequently crushing the nearby village worshipping the Vanir God, Njörd, freezing the village and killing all of the inhabitants with his final breath.

characters.title: Thiazzi
characters.about: Thiazi is a Jotunn and a character featured in God of War (2018). He is the father of Skaði.

characters.title: Thrym
characters.about: Thrym is a Jötunn featured in God of War (2018). He was a Frost Giant King who stole Thor's hammer, Mjölnir.
characters.quote: "Thrym the cunning" ransomed Mjölnir for Freya, and Odin went along to sneak Thor into Jötunheim. If not for Freya, he might have killed every last Giant there! –Codex

characters.title: Ullr
appearsIn: The Lost Pages of Norse Myth (mentioned only)
characters.about: Ullr (Old Norse: Ull), is a Norse God of Archery, Hunt, Sports and Skiing.

characters.title: Unnr
characters.about: Unnr is a Norse Goddess of Waves and one of the Nine Daughters of Ægir and Rán.

characters.title: Vili
appearsIn: God of War (2018) (mentioned and pictured only)
The Lost Pages of Norse Myth (mentioned only)
characters.about: Vili also known as Vili Borrson (Translation: Vili, Son of Borr) is the Norse God of Wit, touch, sense. He is the younger brother of Odin and elder brother of Vé. He is the uncle of Thor, Týr, Heimdall, and Baldur.

characters.title: Vé
appearsIn: God of War (2018) (mentioned and pictured only)
The Lost Pages of Norse Myth (mentioned only)
characters.about: Vé also known as Vé Borrson (Translation: Vé, Son of Borr) is the Norse God of countenance, speech, hearing, and sight. He is the younger brother of Odin and Vili. He is the uncle of Thor, Týr, Heimdall and Baldur.

characters.title: Ymir
appearsIn: God of War (2018) (mentioned and pictured only)
characters.about: Ymir was the original Jötunn, the first being that came into existence in the Nine Realms and the progenitor of all living creatures.
characters.quote: Tell me, can you murder a landslide? Smother a storm? He was more... a force of nature. A vessel of power. –Odin to Atreus about Ymir

characters.title: Ægir
characters.about: Ægir is a Aesir God of the Sea and the maternal grandfather of Heimdall, the Watchman of the Aesir.

characters.title: Althjof
characters.about: Althjof was a Dwarven Thief, living in Svartalfheim who constantly rallied against the Aesir until his demise.
characters.quote: I recall Althjof the Thief's antics. He understood one of the most important rules of resistance: you don't always need to win major battles. You just need to inconvenience your invaders. –Mimir

characters.title: Alva
characters.about: Alva was the Light Elf Queen of Alfheim and a boss in God of War Ragnarök.

characters.title: Alvíss Stonefoot
characters.about: Alvíss was a male dwarf living in Svartalfheim, he was the warden and there was a giant statue built in his honor.
characters.quote: Alvíss Stonefoot, Warden of Svartalfheim. He used his wisdom and might to imprison some of the most dangerous creatures in all the realm. –Mimir

characters.title: Angrboda
characters.about: Angrboda (Old Norse: Angrboða, Nordic: ᚨᚾᚷᚱᛒᛟᛞᚨ) is a Jötunn, the best friend and love interest of Loki, and the current owner of Fenrir. She is also one of the last remaining giants of Jötunheim, the other being her Grandmother Grýla.
characters.quote: I decided that it would better if I wrote the ending myself. –Angrboda to Atreus

characters.title: Astrid
characters.about: Astrid was a female Vanir worshiper of the Goddess Freya, she was the caretaker and creator of Noatun's Garden. Her goal was to keep the plants in bloom until her Queen would one day return to her rightful home, Vanaheim.
characters.quote: Astrid: Freya... you return. Freya: Astrid... What happened to you? To your garden? Astrid: The Einherjar. My life's work, rotted. My monument to your glory, reduced to this. I am sorry, my queen. –Astrid and Freya

characters.title: Bari
characters.about: Bari was a dwarf living in Svartalfheim who dedicated his entire life to building the great mead hall until his untimely death.
characters.quote: Bari the Dwarf spent his entire life building the great mead-hall known as Lyr. Brick by brick, stone by stone, he built it as wide and as tall as he could so that the songs and merriment of the Dwarves could echo within its walls until the end of time. –Mimir

characters.title: Beigaðr the Feared
characters.about: Beigaðr the Feared is one of the twelve Berserkers that can be fought as an optional boss in God of War Ragnarök. Located in Svartalfheim, Beigaðr is one of the slightly stronger Berserkers the player can choose to face after getting the Hilt of Skofnung.

characters.title: Berserkers
characters.about: :This article is about the optional bosses in God of War Ragnarök. You may be looking for the cult featured in the Dark Horse Comics.

characters.title: Bestla
characters.about: Bestla is an Aesir Goddess. She is a member of the Aesir Royal Family, being wife of Borr, the mother of Odin, Vili and Vé, grandmother of Thor, Týr, Heimdall, and, Baldur, and great-grandmother of Magni, Modi, Forseti and Thrúd.
characters.quote: You know it doesn't work that way! Though sweet Bestla I wish it did. –Sindri mentions Bestla to Atreus, during their mission.

characters.title: Beyla
characters.about: Beyla is a Dark Elf Warrior. She is the wife of Byggvir and ally to Freyr.

characters.title: Birgir
characters.about: Birgir is a Midgardian Mortal who fought alongside the Vanir Gods. He was a former Traveler before he saw the lies behind Odin's path and chose to side with Vanaheim, causing other Travelers to label him a heretic.
characters.quote: FOR VANAHEIM! –Birgir

characters.title: Blatönn
characters.about: Blatönn is an alpha-werewolf encountered in Vanaheim.

characters.title: Blóðugr Steinn
characters.about: Blóðugr Steinn is a troll that appears as an optional boss in God of War Ragnarök.

characters.title: Brenna Banamaðr
characters.about: Brenna Banamaðr is a fire troll and an optional boss in God of War Ragnarök.

characters.title: Byggvir
characters.about: Byggvir is a Light Elf and is the husband of Beyla. He is an ally of the Vanir God Freyr.

characters.title: Bödvar the Fierce
characters.about: Bödvar the Fierce is one of the twelve Berserkers that can be fought as an optional boss in God of War Ragnarök. Bödvar along with Starólfr the Troublesome can be found in Svartalfheim, in the region between the Jarnsmida Pitmines and Applecore.

characters.title: Cobweb
characters.about: Cobweb of the goodfellows was one of Mimir's faerie-folk friends and the male maid of Queen Titania. He is only ever mentioned in God of War Ragnarök: Valhalla by Mimir.
characters.quote: I found myself reliving old times with my former crew of fairie-folk. Cobweb, Mustardseed, the whole pack of ne'er-do-wells. Such warm greetings for their old ringleader, like nary a day had passed. –Mimir talking about the Goodfellows to Kratos

characters.title: Dagr
characters.about: Dagr was a Prince of Östergötland, brother of Sigrún and son of Högni. He appears in minimal sources of Norse mythology. He is known as the one with the help of the war God Odin slain the mad King Helgi.
characters.quote: 1=My spear drips righteous and red from the blood of that cad, King Helgi. My father, in his wisdom denied him the hand of my sister, Princess Sigrún, knowing his true and dark nature. Enraged by his slight, King Helgi gathered his forces and invaded our land, determined to claim his bride. –2=Dagr's letter

characters.title: Daudi Vörðr
characters.about: Daudi Vörðr (meaning Death Warden or Death Watcher) was a Troll that appears as a minor enemy in God of War Ragnarök. Like Dauði Kaupmaðr from the previous game, he is the first fire troll to be encountered, however, unlike the former, he is the only one canonically encountered in the main storyline as all other troll encounters throughout the game are optional.

characters.title: Duneyrr
characters.about: Duneyrr is a Seasonal Stag from Yggdrasil, representing the season of Autumn.

characters.title: Durinn
characters.about: Durinn was a Dwarven Smith, living in Svartalfheim who truly believed Svartalfheim could flourish from his creation and hoped to give the Dwarves independence.
characters.quote: Durinn the Generous built the World-Mill over the course of decades, He foresaw a future in which Svartalfheim was as lush and verdant as the most overgrown fields in Vanaheim, and the World-Mill was the first step toward that future. He'd sell fertile, high-quality soil to the other Dwarves and pour all the proceeds into keeping the World-Mill running. –Mimir

characters.title: Durlin
characters.about: Durlin is a dwarf and an official in Svartalfheim. He was also a former rebel leader, who, alongside Laufey, led a failed coup against the Aesir, in which he was severely punished by Heimdall. He has a pet Kraken named Dínner.
characters.quote: Here to collect on something, pal? Think, uh, parading a severed head around on your hip is gonna scare me into somehow approving Estrid's accretion proposal, eh? –Durlin meeting Kratos

characters.title: Dvalinn
characters.about: Dvalinn is a Seasonal Stag from Yggdrasil, representing the season of Summer.

characters.title: Dáinn
characters.about: Dáinn is a Seasonal Deer from Yggdrasil, representing the season of Spring.

characters.title: Egil The Oath Guard
characters.about: Egil the Oath Guard is an optional boss introduced in God of War: Ragnarök. He is one of the Oath Guards and a former brother of Birgir.

characters.title: Einherjar Thief
characters.about: The Einherjar Thief is an enemy Einherjar Tamer, which prevents Kratos and Atreus from recovering the Moon.

characters.title: Eisa
characters.about: Eisa is a fox that accompany the giantess Angrboda that she rides when she raced Atreus in Jötunheim.
characters.quote: First the wolves, then a yak, and now a magical fox with huge ears?! Angrboda sure has a lot of animal friends. During our race rematch, Eisa was fast–like, REALLY fast–even with Angrboda on her back! I almost kept up with her, but yeah... I still lost. It felt good to finally be in control of my wolf form though. I just had to think about Angrboda and what she must be felling–holding ono, I dunno, compassion or sometheing to keep the rage in check? Huh. I wonder if that's how father does it?" –Atreus' description of Eisa

characters.title: Erlend
characters.about: Erlend is one of the Asgardians that can briefly be seen in the game God of War: Ragnarök during Atreus' adventure in Asgard
characters.quote: Erlend, try to stay awake. For me? –Odin to Erlend

characters.title: Fenrir
characters.about: Fenrir (Nordic: ᚠᛖᚾᚱᛁᚱ) is the elderly and sick wolf of Atreus and Kratos. After his death, Atreus subconsciously casts a spell that transfers his part of his soul to his knife. During the fight with Garm, Atreus transfers the piece of Fenrir's soul to the Hound of Helheim, changing its nature and resurrecting Fenrir, who aids them during the events of Ragnarök.

characters.title: Fiske
characters.about: Fiske is a captain of the Einherjar and a boss in God of War Ragnarök. He is found in Vanaheim.

characters.title: Forseti
characters.about: Forseti (Old Norse: Fosite) also known as Forseti Baldurson (Translation: Forseti, Son of Baldur) is the Norse God of Justice and Reconciliation. He is the son of Baldur and Nanna, grandson of Odin and Freya, the nephew of Thor, Týr and Heimdall, and the cousin of Magni, Modi and Thrúd. He is a member of the Aesir Royal Family.

characters.title: Frækni the Zealous
characters.about: Frækni the Zealous is one of the twelve Berserkers that can be fought as an optional boss in God of War Ragnarök. Located in Midgard, Frækni is one of the first Berserkers you can choose to face after obtaining the Hilt of Skofnung.

characters.title: Garm
characters.about: Garm (Nordic: ᚵᚨᛗᛦ), also known Hróðvitnir (Nordic: ᚼᚱᚢᚦᚠᛁᛏᚾᛁᛦ) by the Aesir and Fenrir (Nordic: ᚠᛖᚾᚱᛁᚱ) after his death, was a Jötunn monstrous wolf that was imprisoned in Helheim and is the father of Sköll and Hati.
characters.quote: If the Hound of Hel is let loose, he'll chew through the fabric of the realms. Hel-Walkers are just the beginning. –Freya's reaction to Atreus freeing Garm

characters.title: Geirdriful
characters.about: Geirdriful is a Valkyrie introduced in God of War (2018). She is one of the nine Valkyries who have been cursed by Odin to remain in a corporal form, eventually driving them to insanity. As she became too dangerous, Geirdriful eventually found herself sealed away by the Valkyrie Queen in Midgard. She is nevertheless freed by Kratos and Atreus after they engaged and defeated her physical form. Blessing them with her eternal gratitude, her spirit vanished and eventually reunited with her sisters.
characters.quote: The Master of Arms in Valhalla. Responsible for arming and training Odin’s Einherjar. His army, come Ragnarök. The Einherjar wait in the Great Hall, endlessly feasting, drinking, and fu— ahem uh... fornicating themselves silly. Once Ragnarök begins, Odin calls them into service to fight on his behalf. Geirdriful had her hands full, training that lot. –Mimir's remarks about Geirdriful

characters.title: Geri & Freki
characters.about: Geri and Freki are two wolves that accompany the god Odin. After a successful battle, Odin walks over the bodies of his defeated opponents while Geri and Freki devour their bodies.

characters.title: Gná
characters.about: Gná (Old Norse: gnɑ) was the Vanir Goddess of Swift Travel, and Freya's former handmaiden. She is introduced in God of War Ragnarök as the new Queen of the Valkyries, since Sigrún regained her freedom following her defeat at the hands of Kratos and Atreus, three years ago.
characters.quote: GOOD! I will see you PAY for what you have done. –Gná blaming Freya and Kratos for Asgard's destruction.

characters.title: Griep
characters.about: Griep was a Dwarven Scribe, living in Svartalfheim who constantly rallied against the Aesir until her demise.
characters.quote: Griep was a fantastically angry Dwarven Scribe. Her furious treatises against Odin's financial imperialism might as well have spurred the Dwarves to outright rebellion, had she continued to distribute them. –Mimir

characters.title: Grýla
characters.about: Grýla is an elderly Giantess and is the grandmother of Angrboda. She appears as a minor antagonist in God of War Ragnarök.
characters.quote: She used to leave me food. She'd say she didn't care about me. But sometimes I'd wake up and I'd see a loaf of bread sitting next to the fire. Baked just the way she always used to. She's not a monster, you know? She's lost. –Angrboda to Atreus after breaking the Cauldron

characters.title: Gulltoppr
characters.about: Gulltoppr is Heimdall's personal steed that serves as his official mount to protect the kingdom of Asgard.
characters.quote: Wow, that's almost as impressive as Baldur taming a dragon! –Loki to Heimdall on his mastery of Gulltoppr

characters.title: Gunhild
characters.about: Gunhild was a female Vanir worshiper of the Goddess Freya, she suggested using Seiðr magic with her friends to defend themselves from the Einherjar's destruction, but her plan backfired. She was murdered and her friends cursed.
characters.quote: We shouldn't have played with such magic. Regret is my only company. –Gunhild

characters.title: Göndul
characters.about: Göndul is a Valkyrie introduced in God of War (2018). She is one of the nine Valkyries who have been cursed by Odin to remain in a corporal form, eventually driving them to insanity. As she became too dangerous, Göndul eventually found herself sealed away by the Valkyrie Queen in Muspelheim. Widely considered as the most powerful of the Valkyries after Sigrún, she is nevertheless freed by Kratos and Atreus after they engaged and defeated her physical form. Blessing them with her eternal gratitude, her spirit vanished and eventually reunited with her sisters.
characters.quote: The sight of Gondul always took my breath away. Gondul had a silver tongue, a sharp wit, and struck a figure so stunning, it literally drove men insane. Odin forbid her from setting foot in Midgard after a time, as insanity is not a welcome trait in Valhalla. –Mimir's remarks about Gondul

characters.title: Hafgufa
characters.about: Hafgufa are giant jellyfish-like creatures that live in Alfheim. There are two that can be encountered in God of War Ragnarök.
characters.quote: Great Gefjon's ghost! That's the largest bloody Hafgufa I've ever laid eyes on! –Mimir upon seeing the Hafgufa

characters.title: Haklangr the Bearded
characters.about: Haklangr the Bearded is one of the twelve Berserkers that can be fought as an optional boss in God of War Ragnarök. Haklangr can be found in The Sinkholes in Vanaheim, near the Mystic Gateway.

characters.title: Harðrefill the Callous
characters.about: Harðrefill the Callous is one of the twelve Berserkers that can be fought as an optional boss in God of War Ragnarök. Located in Svartalfheim, Harðrefill is likely the first Berserker the player will encounter after getting the Hilt of Skofnung.

characters.title: Helgi
aliases: The mad King (by Dagr, Högni & Mimir)
characters.about: King Helgi also known as Helgi Hundingsbane is regarded as a hero in Norse sagas. He is known for his affections towards Princess Sigrún and the responsible for the destruction of the Kingdom Östergötland.
characters.quote: 1=King Helgi massacred her family just because he couldn't have her. Only her brother, Prince Dagr, survived to kill the mad king. –2=Mimir talking about Sigrún's past with Kratos

characters.title: Helka
characters.about: Helka is Lunda's pet and is the faithful companion of Freyr and his allies. She makes her debut in God of War: Ragnarok

characters.title: Hildr
characters.about: Hildr is a Valkyrie introduced in God of War (2018). She is one of the nine Valkyries who have been cursed by Odin to remain in a corporal form, eventually driving them to insanity. As she became too dangerous, Hildr eventually found herself sealed away by the Valkyrie Queen in Niflheim. She is nevertheless freed by Kratos and Atreus after they engaged and defeated her physical form. Blessing them with her eternal gratitude, her spirit vanished and eventually reunited with her sisters.
characters.quote: Mistress of Battle. She and Odin got on quite well, actually. Her and the other Valkyries... not so much. She would spend most of her time here in Midgard, observing discord between the living, and stirring some up herself from time to time. She lived for conflict. Some say she WAS conflict, personified. I wonder what will become of her, now that she's free. –Mimir’s remarks about Hildr

characters.title: Hjalti the Stolid
characters.about: Hjalti the Stolid is one of the twelve Berserkers that can be fought as an optional boss in God of War Ragnarök. Hjalti the Stolid can be found south of The Burrows, in The Forbidden Sands located in Alfheim.

characters.title: Hreidmar
characters.about: Hreidmar was the father of Reginn, Fafnir, and Otr. Hreidmar's Brassard is a Collectible in the unique series of Artifacts known as "Things Left Behind" which can only be found in Svartalfheim.
characters.quote: Hreidmar is known for two things: firstly, he was one of the great armorers of Svartalfheim. Secondly his sons are all dragons. That's right Hreidmar fathered the dragons you know now as Regin, Fafnir, and Otr. –Mimir

characters.title: Huginn & Muninn
characters.about: Huginn and Muninn are Odin's eyes and ears. This pair of ravens fly all over the realms, serving as his personal spies and bringing him precious information.
characters.quote: These two aren't like the spies we see around the realms. Huginn and Muninn are Odin's own weird magical pets. Back at the house, I saw them disappear into his tattoos! Mimir told me once how they came to be that way - how they were normal ravens once, until Odin captured their whole unkindness. Most of them he roasted and ate for supper, but on Huginn and Muninn he experimented, wiping their memories and binding them to his will. Mimir also referred to them as "right pricks, even for birds." –Atreus' description of Huginn and Muninn

characters.title: Hvítserkr the Bold
characters.about: Hvítserkr The Bold is one of the twelve Berserkers that can be fought as an optional boss in God of War Ragnarök. Hvítserkr The Bold can be found in the Southern Wilds in Vanaheim. Head onward to the Pilgrim's Landing, to the circular white structure.

characters.title: Högni
characters.about: Högni was a king of Östergötland, father of Sigrún and Dagr who appears in sources of Norse mythology.
characters.quote: My father, in his wisdom denied him the hand of my sister, Princess Sigrún, knowing his true and dark nature. –Dagr mentioning his father

characters.title: Imposter Tyr
characters.about: Impostor Tyr, or the ”Týr“ that Kratos and Atreus had freed in Svartalfheim, was actually Odin in disguise, who posed as his own son as a means to infiltrate Kratos' circle of allies and know their plans. This also unexpectedly led him to discover the secret prophecies that the Jötnar had hidden in their shrines. Odin eventually drops his disguise altogether in a moment of anger when he kills Brok.
characters.quote: I know you... God killer... Have you come for me now? –Odin disguised as Týr for Kratos

characters.title: Iron Wolves
characters.about: The Iron wolves are a pack of wolves that accompany the giantess Angrboda.

characters.title: Jalla
characters.about: Jalla is a yak that accompanies the giantess Angrboda that she rides when she does her daily routine of feeding the soulless animals her grandmother Grýla created in Ironwood. It is very clear and apparent, Angrboda is great friends with all of her animal friends she cares for, but Jalla is rather special to her. You can tell there is a great bond even on Jalla's part by the way we get to see them briefly interact in specific scenes.
characters.quote: Angrboda has a yak named Jalla. It was funny—she said "I want you to meet someone" and I thought for a moment there might be more giants, but she meant Jalla. I get the sense Jalla might be her best friend which maybe sounds sad I guess, but I think its kind of amazing. Makes me miss Fenrir, though I also still feel like he's with me somehow. I wish she could have met him. It must be lonely living here, but I know how much it helps having a connection to animals. –Atreus' description of Jalla

characters.title: Jörgen
characters.about: Jörgen is a minor character who appears in God of War Ragnarök. Little is known about him, except that he is an Asgardian resident and possible cook for the Aesir Gods. Jörgen is encountered during Atreus' visit to Asgard, where Odin will casually strike up one-sided conversation with him and warn against the use of mushrooms in his meals.

characters.title: Jørgen The Oath Guard
characters.about: Jørgen The Oath Guard is a Traveler and a boss that is introduced in God of War: Ragnarök. He is one of Birgir's sworn brothers, who blindly follow The Path.

characters.title: Kara
characters.about: Kara is a Valkyrie introduced in God of War (2018). She is one of the nine Valkyries who have been cursed by Odin to remain in a corporal form, eventually driving them to insanity. As she became too dangerous, Kara eventually found herself sealed away by the Valkyrie Queen in Midgard. She is nevertheless freed by Kratos and Atreus after they engaged and defeated her physical form. Blessing them with her eternal gratitude, her spirit vanished and eventually reunited with her sisters.
characters.quote: Wild Storm personified. Calm and collected... Then the air would shift, and the fury of her storm would unleash. It was beautiful, in a way, assuming you could find proper shelter. Her tears would cleanse the blood-soaked battlefields. –Mimir's remarks about Kara

characters.title: Karl
characters.about: Karl is a minor character who appears in God of War Ragnarök. Little is known about him, except that he is an Asgardian resident of Gladsheim. Karl is encountered during Atreus' visit to Asgard, where Odin will tell him to steady himself as he drinks.

characters.title: King Aldis
characters.about: King Aldis was a king that was mentioned in God of War Ragnarök. Mimir became the advisor for Aldis before he was murdered by Hrólfr Kraki.

characters.title: King Hrólf Kraki
characters.about: King Hrólf Kraki is a Berserker that appears as an optional boss in God of War Ragnarök. Out of all the berserkers that can be encountered, Hrólf Kraki, like Sigrún of the Valkyries, is the strongest and most powerful out of all of them. He can be found in Midgard.

characters.title: Kvasir
characters.about: Kvasir is the Vanir God of poetry, Peace, Mead and Wisdom.

characters.title: Lofnheid
characters.about: Lofnheid was a Dwarven Waitress living in Svartalfheim who secretly killed the Aesir in the night.
characters.quote: The Einherjar never believed the adorable tavern waitress who served them with a twinkle in her eye and a smile on her lips could also be the one butchering them come nightfall. But butcher them she did. Got eleven of them before she was finally caught. And even when they executed her, they said she had that same twinkle in her eye. That same smile on her lips. –Mimir

characters.title: Lúnda
characters.about: is a female dwarven blacksmith who is friends with Brok and Sindri. With smithing skills comparable to the Huldra brothers, she works in support of Freyr's resistance efforts.

characters.title: Mari
characters.about: Mari was a female Vanir worshiper of the Goddess Freya, she was patiently waiting for Freya to return to Vanaheim in hopes Freya would heal her from her sickness, Mari was unaware she was already dead.
characters.quote: Please- leave me to my prayers. I await Freya, the great healer... –Mari to Kratos

characters.title: Miklimunnr
characters.about: Miklimunnr is a fire troll that appears as an optional boss in God of War Ragnarök.

characters.title: Moth
characters.about: Moth of the goodfellows was one of Mimir's faerie-folk friends and the male maid of Queen Titania. He is only ever hinted at in God of War Ragnarök: Valhalla by Mimir.
characters.quote: 1=I found myself reliving old times with my former crew of fairie-folk. Cobweb, Mustardseed, the whole pack of ne'er-do-wells. Such warm greetings for their old ringleader, like nary a day had passed. –2=Mimir talking about the Goodfellows to Kratos

characters.title: Mustardseed
characters.about: Mustardseed of the goodfellows was one of Mimir's faerie-folk friends and the male maid of Queen Titania. He is only ever mentioned in God of War Ragnarök: Valhalla by Mimir.
characters.quote: I found myself reliving old times with my former crew of fairie-folk. Cobweb, Mustardseed, the whole pack of ne'er-do-wells. Such warm greetings for their old ringleader, like nary a day had passed. –Mimir talking about the Goodfellows to Kratos

characters.title: Nimue
characters.about: Nimue is a Celtic Nymph, a woman expert in creating swords, responsible for creating the famous sword Excalibur. She is mentioned by Mimir in God of War Ragnarök

characters.title: Oberon
characters.about: Oberon, also known as the King of the Faeries, is the High King of the Fae, a classification of magical beings, which come from Fairyland, a realm separate from the Human Realm. He is an unseen character in God of War Ragnarök: Valhalla. He is only ever mentioned in passing by Mimir.
characters.quote: And this time I encountered my former boss, King Oberon. Rather eye-opening actually. Used to be a true believer in him. Would have done anything he asked." –Mimir to Kratos while in Valhalla

characters.title: Olrun
characters.about: Olrun is a Valkyrie introduced in God of War (2018). She is one of the Nine Valkyries who have been cursed by Odin to remain in a corporal form, eventually driving them to insanity. As she became too dangerous, Olrun eventually found herself sealed away by the Valkyrie Queen in Alfheim. She is nevertheless freed by Kratos and Atreus after they engaged and defeated her physical form. Blessing them with her eternal gratitude, her spirit vanished and eventually reunited with her sisters.
characters.quote: Once the daughter of a powerful chieftain, she fell defending him during a Reaver attack. Olrun was escorted to Valhalla, where she chose to devote her after-life to the pursuit of knowledge above all else. Quite unusual behavior amongst the constant drinking and feasting of her fellow Valhallian-denizens. Odin saw a kindred spirit in Olrun's single-minded pursuit of knowledge and appointed her as the Valkyrie's resident historian. –Mimir's remarks about Olrun

characters.title: Oluf Nautson
characters.about: Oluf Nautson was a chieftan raider who lived in Midgard along with other Kol Raiders.

characters.title: Peaseblossom
characters.about: Peaseblossom of the goodfellows was one of Mimir's faerie-folk friends and the male maid of Queen Titania. He is only ever hinted at in God of War Ragnarök: Valhalla by Mimir.
characters.quote: 1=I found myself reliving old times with my former crew of fairie-folk. Cobweb, Mustardseed, the whole pack of ne'er-do-wells. Such warm greetings for their old ringleader, like nary a day had passed. –2=Mimir talking about the Goodfellows to Kratos

characters.title: Rán
appearsIn: God of War Ragnarök: Valhalla (mentioned only)
characters.about: Rán is the Goddess of the Sea, wife of Ægir and grandmother of Heimdall.
characters.quote: It won't be long now. Will Aegir be understanding? Will Rán be compassionate? (...) I suppose it is not for me to know. –A sailor's diary

characters.title: Ræb
characters.about: Ræb is a character in God of War Ragnarök. He is a dwarven musician and proprietor of the tavern in Niðavellir. His creation was inspired and portrayed by Bear McCreary, the composer of the God of War games.

characters.title: Róta
characters.about: Róta is a Valkyrie introduced in God of War (2018). She is one of the nine Valkyries who have been cursed by Odin to remain in a corporal form, eventually driving them to insanity. As she became too dangerous, Róta eventually found herself sealed away by the Valkyrie Queen in Helheim. She is nevertheless freed by Kratos and Atreus after they engaged and defeated her physical form. Blessing them with her eternal gratitude, her spirit vanished and eventually reunited with her sisters.
characters.quote: One of the Choosers of the Slain. Róta was the first to go mad after being imprisoned in a physical form. Sigrún stashed her in Helheim to keep her away from harming herself or others. Mostly others. –Mimir’s remarks about Róta

characters.title: Sinmara
characters.about: Sinmara is a Jötunn who existed before the creation of the Nine Realms and survived the flood caused by Ymir's death. She is the lover and wife of Surtr.
characters.quote: I had hoped that the next time I left Niflheim. it would be to reunite with Surtr. I suppose, in a way, I still am. We promise to keep ourselves separated for the good of all creation and THIS is the thanks we get? And I'm somehow expected to do this--to go through this without him by my side? I'll see you soon, my love. –Cut dialogue of Sinmara

characters.title: Sisters of Illska
characters.voiceActor: Hrómundr the Cruel: Kozue Saito (Japanese dub)
characters.about: Hrómundr the Cruel and Vöttr the Prideful, known together as the Sisters of Illska, are two of the twelve Berserkers that can be fought as an optional boss in God of War Ragnarök. Fighting them will also require to fight Svipdagr the Cold. The Sisters, along with Svipdagr, can be found in Alfheim.

characters.title: Skjóthendi the Unerring
characters.about: Skjóthendi the Unerring is one of the twelve Berserkers that can be fought as an optional boss in God of War Ragnarök. Skjothendi can be encountered in the Mist Fields of Niflheim.

characters.title: Skjöldr
characters.about: Skjöldr is a Midgardian mortal who was taken in by Odin to the realm Asgard. Skjöldr, along with the other Midgardians are placed in a settlement named "New Midgard".
characters.quote: I may owe Odin my life but I don't owe him my death. –Skjöldr

characters.title: Skuld
characters.about: Skuld is a Norse Goddess of Fate and one of the three Norns encountered during The Word of Fate.

characters.title: Speki & Svanna
characters.about: Speki and Svanna are two wolves introduced in God of War Ragnarök. They are both Atreus and Kratos' pet wolves (besides Fenrir).

characters.title: Starólfr the Troublesome
characters.about: Staróflr the Troublesome is one of the twelve Berserkers that can be fought as an optional boss in God of War Ragnarök. Staróflr, along with Bödvar the Fierce can be found in Svartalfheim in the region between the Jarnsmida Pitmines and Applecore.

characters.title: Stinnr & Sterkr
characters.about: Stinnr and Sterkr are a pair of optional postgame bosses introduced in God of War: Ragnarök.

characters.title: Surtr
characters.about: Surtr, also known as Surt, is the first and last fire giant and the second being to be born in the Norse cosmos. He rules Muspelheim and commands the fire giants. Hidden deep within his realm, he spent millennia training and preparing for Ragnarök, where he was destined to lead his kin against the Aesir and destroy Asgard. He was fated to die in the process, but his actions would ensure the cycle of life could be reborn.
characters.quote: Sometimes loving someone is about choosing the lesser pain –Surtr

characters.title: Svipdagr the Cold
characters.about: Svipdagr the Cold is one of the twelve Berserkers that can be fought as an optional boss in God of War Ragnarök. She is fought alongside the Sisters of Illska. Svipdagr, along with the Sisters, can be found in Alfheim.

characters.title: Tanngrisnir & Tanngnjóstr
characters.about: Tanngrisnir and Tanngnjóstr are the goats who pull the chariot of the god Thor.
characters.quote: Hey, Thor requested those damned goats-favorite pets who had long since expired. –Sindri about Mjölnir's pommel

characters.title: The Everlasting
characters.about: The Everlasting is introduced as a boss in God of War: Ragnarök.

characters.title: The Huntress
characters.about: The Huntress is a powerful Stalker and a boss in God of War: Ragnarök.

characters.title: The Lady of the Forge
characters.about: The Lady of the Forge, or simply known as The Lady, is a mystical mermaid like creature who appears as a supporting character in God of War Ragnarök. She is well known for forging weapons by melding different resources together with her magic. The Lady is the creator of the Draupnir Spear.

characters.title: The Raven Keeper
characters.about: The Raven Keeper was a minor antagonist in God of War Ragnarök. She was Odin's trusted acolyte and was responsible for creating the Mystical Ravens that were sent as spies throughout the Nine Realms.
characters.quote: Get away from my children. Have you any idea how long it took to shape their spirits into something useful? Have you any idea of the EFFORT? The FOCUS? Were it not for me, these misbegotten urchins would have perished in the winds of Fimbulwinter. But instead? They became something greater. Something magnificent. They MATTERED to the All-Father...and they mattered to ME. –The Raven Keeper to Kratos

characters.title: Thrúd
aliases: Finest Valkyrie These Realms Have Ever Seen (by Sif)
characters.about: Thrúd (Old Norse: Þrúðr, Nordic: ᚦᚱᚢᛞ) also known as Thrúd Thorsdóttir (Thrúd, Daughter of Thor), is the daughter of Thor and Sif, the granddaughter of Odin and Fjörgyn, the niece of Týr, Heimdall and Baldur, the younger sister of Modi and half-sister of Magni. After her father's death in Ragnarök, she inherits his hammer Mjölnir and his mantle titles as the Goddess of Thunder for herself.
characters.quote: Seeing the Valkyries fight- all strength and style, no apologies- it gave me clarity. For the first time, I saw my path forward. Clear as day. –Thrúd to Loki

characters.title: Titania
characters.about: Titania is the wife of King Oberon, thus making her the Queen of the Faeries. They reside in Fairyland also known as Avalon. Queen Titania's four maids were Mimir's friends Mustardseed, Peaseblossom, Moth and Cobweb.
characters.quote: Were you an ally to Freya in her suffering? To Skaði? To Gróa? Or Titania? No! –The illusion of Sigrún during the trip to the Norns to Mimir

characters.title: Urð
characters.about: Urð (Nordic: Urðr) is a Norse Goddess of Fate and one of the three Norns encountered during The Word of Fate.
characters.quote: You are looking for what all those who search for us seek, to know the end to your story. –Urð

characters.title: Verðandi
characters.about: Verðandi is a Norse Goddess of Fate and one of the three Norns encountered during The Word of Fate.

characters.title: Vísi Haglkorn
characters.about: Vísi Haglkorn is an ice troll that appears in God of War Ragnarök as an optional boss Kratos can fight.
